body.heading: Moments of turning toward
paragraphs: Relationship researchers talk about small bids for connection — the moments when one partner reaches out with a comment, a touch, a joke. Couples who habitually turn toward those bids, even briefly, build up a reserve of goodwill.
These moments take seconds. The reserve they build lasts through the hard weeks when nobody has energy for grand gestures.

body.heading: Rituals worth stealing
paragraphs: Coffee made for the other person without being asked. A real hello and goodbye — phones down, eyes up. Ten minutes at the end of the day that belong to the two of you, even if you spend them saying nothing much.
The ritual does not matter nearly as much as the repetition. Choose one, keep it small, and let it become the thing you do even — especially — on tired days.

description: Couples stay close less through grand gestures than through tiny rituals of turning toward each other.
